concerns.text: T006 consumes '$\Delta$ similarity' for the full 10-language study, but no producer task exists for the full similarity matrix. T003 is explicitly a 'thin end-to-end analysis on a reduced set (2 models... 2 languages)', leaving a gap between the thin verification and the full statistical analysis.

T006 consumes WALS features and XTREME performance data to calculate Pearson $r$, but there is no task to acquire or process these datasets into a usable format. T001 only verifies the URLs; it does not produce the data artifacts required by T006.
